title: command
description: Open: a write/command scope (#[Refresh]/#[Purge]); purges nest under it.

annotations.description: the #[Refresh]/#[Purge] annotations on the command method; empty on the CacheableResponse (donut-command) path by design — that path refreshes by resource identity, not by annotation

source.description: class basename of the producing interceptor; built-in producers are CommandInterceptor, DonutCommandInterceptor and RefreshInterceptor, but any custom command interceptor may appear here
